Short staggered weathered gray-brown timber boards, broad 4px planks, charcoal 1px seams, one tiny pale salt-wear cluster contained away from edges. 4-6 discrete muted flat colors, hard square pixel clusters, no antialiasing. Break long seams with offset board ends. Exclude room lighting, highlight corner, cast shadow, rails, grid frame, puddles, text, logo.
